cli.usage.title: mathgeo — headless command line for the elementary geometry kernel
cli.usage.body:
Usage:
  mathgeo render      <problem.json> [-o out.svg] [--dark] [--width 960]
  mathgeo validate    <problem.json>
  mathgeo inspect     <problem.json>
  mathgeo gallery     <folder> [-o out.html] [--dark]
  mathgeo interactive <folder> [-o out.html]

Global options:
  --lang <code>       language for the UI and diagnostics, e.g. zh-Hans / en / ja (16 available)

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  the problem has errors (the solvable part is still written)
  2  usage or file error
cli.render.partial: Solving did not fully succeed; the solved part is still written
cli.inspect.title: Problem: {0}
cli.inspect.sectionEmpty: {0} has no cross-section (the plane misses the solid)
cli.inspect.dihedralEmpty: {0} has no plane angle (the faces are not adjacent)
diag.schema.version.tooNew: schema version {0} is newer than the supported {1}
diag.schema.pointkind: cannot tell the point kind: give pointKind, or one of at / path / derived
diag.schema.at: free point has no at; treating it as the origin
diag.schema.line.endpoints: a line object needs both a and b endpoint ids
diag.schema.circle.radius: circle has neither through nor radius; using radius 0
diag.schema.polygon.vertices: a polygon needs at least 3 vertices
diag.schema.polyhedron.vertices: a polyhedron needs at least 4 vertices
diag.schema.polyhedron.faces: a polyhedron needs at least 4 faces
diag.schema.polyhedron.face: every face needs at least 3 vertices
diag.schema.polyhedron.index: face vertex index out of range: {0}
diag.schema.solid.missing: a solid object needs the solid field (box / prism / pyramid)
diag.schema.section.of: a section needs of: the id of the polyhedron being cut
diag.schema.section.plane: a section needs plane: three point ids defining the plane
diag.schema.dihedral.of: a dihedral needs of: the polyhedron id
diag.schema.dihedral.faces: a dihedral needs faceA and faceB: two face indices
diag.ref.askTarget: ask.target points at a non-existent object '{0}'
diag.ref.lineEndpoints: the endpoints of line '{0}' do not exist
diag.geom.intersection.args: an intersection needs at least two object ids
diag.geom.intersection.missing: an object referenced by the intersection does not exist: {0} / {1}
diag.geom.point: argument {0} points at a missing point '{1}'
diag.geom.line: argument {0} points at a missing line '{1}'
diag.geom.mirror: mirror centre/axis '{0}' is missing or has the wrong type
diag.schema.angle.points: an angle needs vertex / from / to point ids
diag.schema.threeViews.solids: three views need of (one solid) or solids (a list)
diag.geom.sphere.circumscribed: cannot fit a circumscribed sphere: not enough vertices
diag.geom.sphere.inscribed: this polyhedron has no inscribed sphere
diag.schema.sphere.of: a sphere needs of: the polyhedron id
diag.schema.sphere.kind: unrecognised sphere kind: '{0}' (expected circumscribed or inscribed)
cli.inspect.noSphere: no sphere can be fitted to {0}
